# New York Magazine

> New York Magazine chronicles the ideas, people, politics, culture, and products reshaping New York and the wider world.

New York Magazine publishes reporting, criticism, service journalism, and recommendations across several major verticals, including Intelligencer, Vulture, The Cut, Grub Street, Curbed, and The Strategist. It also offers newsletters, print and digital subscriptions, and archives of magazine features and columns.

## Main Sections

- [New York Magazine](https://nymag.com): Homepage featuring top stories across news, culture, criticism, and service journalism.
- [Intelligencer](https://nymag.com/intelligencer/): News and politics vertical covering government, business, media, and technology.
- [Vulture](https://www.vulture.com): Entertainment and culture coverage spanning TV, movies, music, comedy, and books.
- [The Cut](https://www.thecut.com): Style, fashion, beauty, relationships, work, and women’s-interest coverage.
- [Grub Street](https://www.grubstreet.com): Food and restaurant reporting, reviews, recipes, and dining guides.
- [Curbed](https://www.curbed.com): Architecture, real estate, urbanism, and home design coverage.
- [The Strategist](https://nymag.com/strategist/): Product recommendations, shopping guides, and deals coverage.

## News and Politics

- [Intelligencer](https://nymag.com/intelligencer/): Central hub for political news, analysis, and reporting from New York and Washington.
- [Politics](https://nymag.com/intelligencer/politics/): Political coverage focused on elections, campaigns, policy, and government power.
- [Business](https://nymag.com/intelligencer/business/): Reporting and analysis on markets, companies, labor, and the economy.
- [Media](https://nymag.com/intelligencer/media/): Coverage of journalism, publishing, television, and the media industry.
- [Technology](https://nymag.com/intelligencer/technology/): Reporting on tech companies, platforms, AI, and internet culture.
- [Daily Intelligencer](https://nymag.com/intelligencer/tags/daily-intelligencer/): Frequently updated stream of shorter news items and political observations.

## Entertainment and Culture

- [Vulture](https://www.vulture.com): Main culture site for criticism, interviews, recaps, and entertainment news.
- [TV](https://www.vulture.com/tv/): Television reviews, recaps, interviews, and streaming recommendations.
- [Movies](https://www.vulture.com/movies/): Film criticism, festival coverage, interviews, and box-office reporting.
- [Music](https://www.vulture.com/music/): Music news, album reviews, criticism, and artist interviews.
- [Comedy](https://www.vulture.com/comedy/): Coverage of stand-up, late night, sketch, and comedy culture.
- [Books](https://www.vulture.com/books/): Book criticism, author interviews, and literary coverage.
- [Awards](https://www.vulture.com/awards/): Coverage of Oscars, Emmys, Grammys, Tonys, and awards-season campaigns.

## Style, Beauty, and Life

- [The Cut](https://www.thecut.com): Main hub for fashion, beauty, relationships, work, and modern life coverage.
- [Style](https://www.thecut.com/style/): Fashion reporting, trend coverage, celebrity style, and shopping features.
- [Beauty](https://www.thecut.com/beauty/): Beauty advice, product coverage, trends, and service journalism.
- [Self](https://www.thecut.com/self/): Essays and reported pieces about identity, health, and personal life.
- [Work](https://www.thecut.com/work/): Career advice, workplace reporting, and professional-life features.
- [Sex and Relationships](https://www.thecut.com/sex-relationships/): Reporting and essays on dating, marriage, sex, and family life.
- [Horoscopes](https://www.thecut.com/horoscopes/): Daily, weekly, and monthly astrology forecasts and zodiac features.

## Food and Dining

- [Grub Street](https://www.grubstreet.com): Food vertical covering restaurants, chefs, recipes, and dining culture.
- [Restaurants](https://www.grubstreet.com/restaurants/): Restaurant news, openings, reviews, and dining recommendations.
- [Recipes](https://www.grubstreet.com/recipes/): Recipes, cooking advice, and kitchen-focused food features.
- [Best of New York Restaurants](https://nymag.com/listings/restaurants/): Curated restaurant listings and recommendations from New York Magazine.
- [Bars](https://nymag.com/listings/bars/): Bar listings and nightlife recommendations across New York City.
- [Cheap Eats](https://www.grubstreet.com/tags/cheap-eats/): Budget-friendly restaurant picks and affordable dining guides.

## Home, Real Estate, and Urbanism

- [Curbed](https://www.curbed.com): Coverage of homes, neighborhoods, architecture, and city life.
- [Real Estate](https://www.curbed.com/real-estate/): Reporting on housing markets, buying, renting, and property trends.
- [Architecture](https://www.curbed.com/architecture/): Architecture criticism, building news, and design features.
- [Home Design](https://www.curbed.com/home-design/): Interior design ideas, renovations, and home inspiration.
- [City Life](https://www.curbed.com/city-life/): Urban policy, transit, public space, and neighborhood coverage.
- [Neighborhood Guides](https://nymag.com/neighborhoods/): New York City neighborhood profiles, rankings, and local guides.

## Shopping and Product Recommendations

- [The Strategist](https://nymag.com/strategist/): Product recommendation site covering useful, well-reviewed items across categories.
- [Deals](https://nymag.com/strategist/tags/deals/): Ongoing coverage of sales, discounts, and notable shopping promotions.
- [Gift Guides](https://nymag.com/strategist/tags/gift-guides/): Curated gift recommendations organized by recipient, interest, and occasion.
- [Amazon](https://nymag.com/strategist/tags/amazon/): Shopping coverage focused on Amazon products, sales, and storefront finds.
- [Home](https://nymag.com/strategist/tags/home/): Recommendations for furniture, bedding, cleaning tools, and home essentials.
- [Kitchen and Dining](https://nymag.com/strategist/tags/kitchen-and-dining/): Cookware, appliances, tableware, and kitchen-tool recommendations.
- [Beauty](https://nymag.com/strategist/tags/beauty/): Skincare, makeup, haircare, and grooming product recommendations.
- [Travel](https://nymag.com/strategist/tags/travel/): Luggage, travel accessories, and packing recommendations.

## Guides, Listings, and Service Journalism

- [Best of New York](https://nymag.com/bestofny/): Annual package highlighting standout restaurants, shopping, culture, and city experiences.
- [Listings](https://nymag.com/listings/): Directory of New York Magazine listings for restaurants, bars, and local services.
- [Restaurants Listings](https://nymag.com/listings/restaurants/): Searchable restaurant directory with editorial recommendations and practical details.
- [Doctors](https://nymag.com/health/bestdoctors/): Best Doctors directory and health-related service listings.
- [Approval Matrix](https://nymag.com/approvalmatrix/): Signature culture chart ranking trends, people, and events by taste and status.
- [Daily Horoscopes](https://www.thecut.com/horoscopes/daily.html): Daily zodiac forecasts and astrology guidance from The Cut.

## Magazine, Archives, and Features

- [Features](https://nymag.com/tags/features/): Longform reporting, essays, profiles, and major magazine stories.
- [Archives](https://nymag.com/archives/): Archive access to past New York Magazine issues and historical content.
- [Print Magazine Subscription](https://subs.nymag.com/magazine/subscribe/official-subscription.html): Official subscription page for print and digital magazine access.
- [Cover Stories](https://nymag.com/tags/cover-story/): Collection of major cover packages and marquee feature stories.
- [The Cut Archive](https://www.thecut.com/archive/): Archive of past stories and packages from The Cut.
- [Vulture Archive](https://www.vulture.com/archive/): Archive of entertainment criticism, features, and annual packages.

## Newsletters and Accounts

- [Newsletters](https://nymag.com/newsletters/): Newsletter directory for New York Magazine and its editorial verticals.
- [Subscribe](https://subs.nymag.com/magazine/subscribe/official-subscription.html): Subscription options for magazine access and member benefits.
- [My Account](https://myaccount.nymag.com): Account management for subscribers and registered users.
- [Customer Service](https://nymag.com/customer-service): Help resources for subscriptions, delivery, and account questions.
- [Shop](https://shop.nymag.com): Official merchandise store for New York Magazine branded products.
